description: G3, G10: each git read drift makes (governance diff, Orient blob listing, blob read, untracked status), made to fail on its own, is a check-failed entry naming it and never a silent pass or a finding read from nothing; orient_blob_sha is None when git cannot answer, `absent` only when the Orient tree has no blob there. Git older than 2.24 is refused before drift runs (compared numerically).
